newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end off on Dow fears, Telebras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end off on Dow fears, Telebras.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed down slightly in weak trade as investors, nervously following declines on Wall Street, sold Telebras and other blue chip shares in the afternoon, brokers said.
"The market was highly speculative, especially late in the day," a dealer told Reuters. "A big local player was selling Telebras."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa closed off 0.27 percent to end at 66,315 points on trade totalling just 317 million reais.
Brokers said prices rose by midday, led by bolsa benchmark Telebras, but prices were hit after lunch by a light selling wave the gathered steam up to the close.
Telebras preferred, which made up 44 percent of the day's trade, fell 0.89 percent to end at 77.90 reais while its voting common share ended off 0.98 percent to close at 65.80 reais.
Other key leaders also fell, including Petrobras preferred, off 1.06 percent to close at 140.50 reais, and Minas Gerais state's Cemig power firm, which fell 0.93 percent to 32.00 reais.
